summary_markdown: The conversation focused on decommissioning several system components. It was confirmed that JCD does not use real-time data, leading to the planned shutdown of certain systems (RMQ and session-related services). A discussion arose regarding the usage of Aerospike within the `sdk-worker` component. The purpose of queues like `sdk_track_event` and `sdk_bind_browser` was questioned. It was noted that `sdk_bind_browser` is no longer needed, but event tracking (captive) still utilizes these mechanisms.
decisions: The use of real-time data from JCD is confirmed to be unnecessary.
RMQ and session services are scheduled for decommissioning/shutdown.
action_items: Investigate the necessity and usage of Aerospike within `sdk-worker`.
Determine if existing queues (`sdk_track_event`, `sdk_bind_browser`) can be simplified or replaced (e.g., moving to Redis).
Confirm continued use of event tracking mechanisms.
